units.rawText: Huh? My smile is captivating and beautiful...? Thank you, Professor.
units.displayText: Huh? My smile is captivating and beautiful...? Thank you, Professor.

spans.text: Huh? My smile is captivating and beautiful...? Thank you, Professor.

units.rawText: Hm? I've been smiling more lately... Have I? So I can make this kind of expression naturally now.
units.displayText: Hm? I've been smiling more lately... Have I? So I can make this kind of expression naturally now.

spans.text: Hm? I've been smiling more lately... Have I? So I can make this kind of expression naturally now.

units.rawText: To rebuild Cyclopes, to break the loop of slaughter, for the vow I made that day... I had to stop Cyclopes from tearing itself apart through action, down to the smallest detail... even just a smile that puts everyone at ease.
units.displayText: To rebuild Cyclopes, to break the loop of slaughter, for the vow I made that day... I had to stop Cyclopes from tearing itself apart through action, down to the smallest detail... even just a smile that puts everyone at ease.

spans.text: To rebuild Cyclopes, to break the loop of slaughter, for the vow I made that day... I had to stop Cyclopes from tearing itself apart through action, down to the smallest detail... even just a smile that puts everyone at ease.

units.rawText: But for someone born to fight like me... smiling was very hard. No matter how many times I practiced alone in front of the mirror, it still felt awkward... nowhere near a smile that makes people feel at ease...
